decoded.meaning: A PATH mixing name and label elements in BOTH orders - a name before a label and a label before a name. RFC-0027 5.2: a PATH MAY carry any mixture, in any order; there is no 'fully minted' state and no all-or-nothing rule, because a hop that does not mint leaves its own part spelled as strings while every other hop's part still compacts.
decoded.note: The second label sits at generation 0xFFFF - the SATURATION point of RFC-0027 4.3.1. It is a legal, usable label; what saturation forbids is the NEXT mint into that slot, which retires permanently rather than wrapping.
